    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    ptr = 0
    T = int(input[ptr])
    ptr += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input[ptr])
        ptr += 1
        C = int(input[ptr])
        ptr += 1
        P = list(map(int, input[ptr:ptr + N]))
        ptr += N
        P.sort()
        left_officers = bisect.bisect_left(P, C)
        right_officers = N - left_officers
        if left_officers == 0 or right_officers == 0:
            results.append((N, 1))
        else:
            max_eliminated = min(left_officers, right_officers)
            if C - P[left_officers - 1] > P[left_officers] - C:
                results.append((max_eliminated, 1))
            elif C - P[left_officers - 1] < P[left_officers] - C:
                results.append((max_eliminated + 1, 1))
            else:
                results.append((max_eliminated, -1))
    for result in results:
        print(result[0], result[1])
